name: Systemic Signs
description: A 15-episode series on the ocular manifestations of systemic disease — diabetes, hypertension, thyroid disease, and the eye signs that prompt a medical workup.

episodes.title: Diabetes and the Eye: The Diabetic Retinopathy Spectrum and the Screening Imperative
episodes.description: The pathophysiology of diabetic retinopathy, the screening intervals for type 1 and type 2 and pregnancy, and the optometrist's role in the diabetes care team.

episodes.title: Hypertensive Retinopathy: The Keith-Wagener-Barker Classification
episodes.description: The KWB grading of hypertensive retinopathy, the malignant hypertension signs, and the cardiovascular risk communication to the patient.

episodes.title: Carotid Artery Disease: Ocular Ischemic Syndrome and the Hollenhorst Plaque
episodes.description: The asymptomatic Hollenhorst plaque, the ocular ischemic syndrome presentation, and the carotid Doppler and cardiovascular referral.

episodes.title: Thyroid Eye Disease: The Active vs Inactive Phase and the Teprotumumab Era
episodes.description: The TED phases, the CAS (clinical activity score), the optic nerve compression red flag, and the new teprotumumab treatment.

episodes.title: Rheumatoid Arthritis and the Eye: Dry Eye, Scleritis, and the systemic-Immune Connection
episodes.description: The RA ocular manifestations (KCS, scleritis, marginal keratitis), the methotrexate and hydroxychloroquine eye effects, and the rheumatology co-management.

episodes.title: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus: The Retinopathy, the Cotton-Wool Spots, and the Hydroxychloroquine
episodes.description: The lupus retinopathy signs, the antiphospholipid syndrome ocular thrombosis, and the hydroxychloroquine screening protocol.

episodes.title: Multiple Sclerosis: The Optic Neuritis Presentation and the Long-Term Monitoring
episodes.description: The optic neuritis as the first MS sign, the ONTT and MRI decision, and the long-term visual monitoring of the MS patient.

episodes.title: Sarcoidosis: The Uveitis, the Candle-Wax Drippings, and the ACE Level
episodes.description: The sarcoid ocular manifestations (uveitis, retinal periphlebitis), the ACE and lysozyme workup, and the chest x-ray and biopsy.

episodes.title: Syphilis and the Eye: The Great Imitator and the Uveitis Workup
episodes.description: The syphilitic uveitis presentations, the RPR and FTA-ABS workup, the lumbar puncture for neurosyphilis, and the IV penicillin treatment.

episodes.title: HIV and the Eye: CMV Retinitis, the Cotton-Wool Spots, and the IRIS Syndrome
episodes.description: The HIV-related ocular manifestations, the CMV retinitis pizza-pie appearance, and the immune recovery uveitis syndrome after HAART.

episodes.title: Sickle Cell Disease: The Sea-Fan Neovascularisation and the Comma Sign
episodes.description: The sickle cell retinopathy (non-proliferative and proliferative), the salmon patch haemorrhage, and the laser and anti-VEGF treatment.

episodes.title: Alzheimer Disease and the Eye: The Retinal Nerve Fibre Layer and the Future Biomarker
episodes.description: The RNFL thinning in Alzheimer disease, the future role of retinal imaging as a biomarker, and the cognitive-friendly exam adaptations.

episodes.title: Sleep Apnoea and Glaucoma: The Floppy Eyelid, the NTG, and the CPAP
episodes.description: The sleep apnoea and glaucoma association, the floppy eyelid syndrome sign, and the CPAP and eye dryness and IOP considerations.

episodes.title: Pregnancy and Vision: The Refractive Shift, the Diabetes, and the Pituitary
episodes.description: The pregnancy-induced refractive shifts, the gestational diabetes retinopathy progression, and the pituitary adenoma and the visual field.

episodes.title: Systemic Medications and the Eye: A Review of the Top 20 Oculotoxic Drugs
episodes.description: A summary of the most common systemic drugs with ocular side effects, the monitoring schedule for each, and the communication with the prescribing physician.
